text:
Predicates:
FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
FliesFrom(x, y) ::: x flies from y.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:
Susan(susan) ∧ Flies(susan) ∧ FliesTo(susan, lga) ∧ FliesFrom(susan, airport) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
¬(FliesTo(susan, airport) ∧ FliesFrom(susan, airport)) ::: The departure and arrival cannot be the same airport.
FliesFrom(john, lga) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
FliesTo(john, lga) ::: John flies to LGA airport.
